rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing a middle-aged person or something associated with middle age.

example.english: They are middle-aged now, but still go running every day.
example.traditional: 佢而家已經係中年，仲日日跑步。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 hai6 zung1 nin4 zung6 jat6 jat6 paau2 bou6

rows.note: Use this conversational description when you want to stress that someone is neither young nor old rather than simply label them 中年.

example.english: They are middle-aged—not young, not old—and still really driven at work.
example.traditional: 佢唔後生唔老，做嘢仲好有衝勁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 m4 hau6 saang1 m4 lou5 zou6 je5 zung6 hou2 jau5 cung1 ging6
